summary: Join our Tourism Policy and Regulation Training Course to gain vital insights and skills. Empower your career and contribute to sustainable tourism practices!
lede: Tourism regulation training helps policy officers, destination managers, and compliance specialists map rules and oversee implementation. Participants practise building licensing inventories, assessing visitor and community impacts, and coordinating compliance monitoring and reporting. They also consider sustainability and visitor protection when developing tourism policy.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, administer, monitor, or advise on tourism policy and regulation across public, private, and destination settings.
modules: Tourism Policy Roadmaps and Executive Briefing
prerequisites: Prior experience in tourism operations, destination management, public policy, hospitality compliance, planning, or regulatory administration is recommended. You should bring working knowledge of tourism stakeholders and basic spreadsheet use. No coding or programming is required. AI-assisted visitor analytics and digital monitoring are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, while policy assessment, mapping, and roadmap exercises receive hands-on practice.
